summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Nomadly/HostBay hosting panel covering login, add-on domains, and all File Manager operations. All core features working correctly. Add-on domain creation, display, quick-nav, and mode selection all functional. File Manager operations (create directory, upload, rename, copy/move, delete, navigation) all working. Minor issue: domain removal may require backend processing time.

minor.issue: Domain removal confirmation dialog accepted but domain still visible immediately after - may need backend processing time or page refresh

issues: React hydration warnings about <span> inside <tbody>/<option>/<select> - pre-existing issue from dev tool wrapper components (data-ve-dynamic spans)

critical_code_review_comments: The hydration warnings about <span> inside <tbody>/<option>/<select> are caused by dev tool wrapper components (x-file-name, x-line-number attributes visible in console). These are development-only and won't affect production.
seed_data_creation: Created test addon domain e2etest1788115571.com, test directory test-dir-e2e-1788115641 (renamed to test-dir-renamed-1788115651), uploaded e2e-test-file.txt
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features tested and working. Login with nbayftest/241743. Dashboard has 8 tabs (Files, Domains, Email, Databases, Security, Geo Cloak, Analytics, Account). Domains tab shows main domain testingbays.sbs with PRIMARY badge, addon domain e2etest1788115571.com with Own Folder badge and NS pending info, and 5 subdomains (api, blog, dev, shop, testbulk1, testbulk2). File Manager in public_html shows subdomain folders plus test files created during testing. All File Manager operations work: create directory, upload, rename, copy/move modal, delete modal, navigation, breadcrumb navigation.
